The kind water, and the daylight, and you--but how should _you_ feel it? It must have gone from my mind to yours."

arxiv-2105-01567.title: Towards Error Measures which Influence a Learners Inductive Bias to the Ground Truth
arxiv-2105-01567.creator: A. I. Parkes, A. J. Sobey, D. A. Hudson
arxiv-2105-01567.description: Abstract Artificial intelligence is applied in a range of sectors, and is relied upon for decisions requiring a high level of trust. For regression methods, trust is increased if they approximate the true input-output relationships and perform accurately outside the bounds of the training data. But often performance off-test-set is poor, especially when data is sparse.

arxiv-2108-00572.title: High-resolution chirplet transform: from parameters analysis to parameters combination
arxiv-2108-00572.creator: Xiangxiang Zhu, Bei Li, Kunde Yang, Zhuosheng Zhang, Wenting Li
arxiv-2108-00572.description: Abstract The standard chirplet transform (CT) with a chirp-modulated Gaussian window provides a valuable tool for analyzing linear chirp signals. The parameters present in the window determine the performance of the CT and play a vital role in high-resolution time-frequency (TF) analysis.

arxiv-2108-04697.title: Large peaks in the entropy of the diluted nearest-neighbor spin-ice model on the pyrochlore lattice in a [111] magnetic field
arxiv-2108-04697.creator: Petr Andriushchenko 1,2, Konstantin Soldatov 1,2, Alexey Peretyatko 1, Yuriy Shevchenko 1,2, Konstantin Nefedev 1,2, Hiromi Otsuka 3, Yutaka Okabe 3
arxiv-2108-04697.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Petr Andriushchenko 1,2, Konstantin Soldatov 1,2, Alexey Peretyatko 1, Yuriy Shevchenko 1,2, Konstantin Nefedev 1,2, Hiromi Otsuka 3, Yutaka Okabe 3. We study the residual entropy of the nearest-neighbor spin-ice model in a magnetic field along the [111] direction using the Wang-Landau Monte Carlo method, with a special attention to dilution effects.

arxiv-2201-13097.title: Sample Optimality and All-for-all Strategies in Personalized Federated and Collaborative Learning
arxiv-2201-13097.description: Abstract . In personalized Federated Learning, each member of a potentially large set of agents aims to train a model minimizing its loss function averaged over its local data distribution. We study this problem under the lens of stochastic optimization.

arxiv-2212-02675.title: Attend Who is Weak: Pruning-assisted Medical Image Localization under Sophisticated and Implicit Imbalances
arxiv-2212-02675.creator: Ajay Jaiswal 1, Tianlong Chen 1, Justin F. Rousseau 1, Yifan Peng 2, Ying Ding 1, Zhangyang Wang 1 ‡
arxiv-2212-02675.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ajay Jaiswal 1, Tianlong Chen 1, Justin F. Rousseau 1, Yifan Peng 2, Ying Ding 1, Zhangyang Wang 1 ‡. Deep neural networks (DNNs) have rapidly become a de facto choice for medical image understanding tasks. However, DNNs are notoriously fragile to the class imbalance in image classification.

arxiv-2303-10873.title: Invariant measures for random piecewise convex maps
arxiv-2303-10873.creator: Tomoki INOUE, Hisayoshi TOYOKAWA
arxiv-2303-10873.description: Abstract . We show the existence of Lebesgue-equivalent conservative and ergodic σ \sigma -finite invariant measures for a wide class of one-dimensional random maps consisting of piecewise convex maps. We also estimate the size of invariant measures around a small neighborhood of a fixed point where the invariant density functions may diverge.

arxiv-2305-00535.title: Nearly Optimal Steiner Trees using Graph Neural Network Assisted Monte Carlo Tree Search
arxiv-2305-00535.creator: Reyan Ahmed, Mithun Ghosh, Kwang-Sung Jun, Stephen Kobourov
arxiv-2305-00535.description: Abstract Graph neural networks are useful for learning problems, as well as for combinatorial and graph problems such as the Subgraph Isomorphism Problem and the Traveling Salesman Problem. We describe an approach for computing Steiner Trees by combining a graph neural network and Monte Carlo Tree Search.

arxiv-2305-04690.title: Exploring light dark matter with the Migdal effect in hydrogen-doped liquid xenon
arxiv-2305-04690.creator: Nicole F. Bell, Peter Cox, Matthew J. Dolan, Jayden L. Newstead, Alexander C. Ritter
arxiv-2305-04690.description: Abstract An ongoing challenge in dark matter direct detection is to improve the sensitivity to light dark matter in the MeV–GeV mass range. One proposal is to dope a liquid noble-element direct detection experiment with a lighter element such as hydrogen.

arxiv-2411-18413.title: Robust Dynamic Gesture Recognition at Ultra-Long Distances
arxiv-2411-18413.creator: Eran Bamani Beeri, Eden Nissinman, Avishai Sintov
arxiv-2411-18413.description: Abstract Dynamic hand gestures play a crucial role in conveying nonverbal information for Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), eliminating the need for complex interfaces. Current models for dynamic gesture recognition suffer from limitations in effective recognition range, restricting their application to close proximity scenarios.

arxiv-2506-17619.title: A C 0 C^{0} weak Galerkin method with preconditioning for constrained optimal control problems with general tracking Thanks: Submitted to a journal in 2025.
arxiv-2506-17619.creator: SeongHee Jeong, Seulip Lee, Kening Wang
arxiv-2506-17619.description: Abstract This paper presents a C 0 C^{0} weak Galerkin ( C 0 C^{0} -WG) method combined with an additive Schwarz preconditioner for solving optimal control problems (OCPs) governed by partial differential equations with general tracking cost functionals and pointwise state constraints.

arxiv-2509-00102.title: Exploiting a Mixture-of-Layers in an Electrocardiography Foundation Model Thanks: 3 The work does not relate to H. Phan’s position at Meta.
arxiv-2509-00102.creator: Phu X. Nguyen 1, Huy Phan 3, Hieu Pham 4, Christos Chatzichristos 1, Bert Vandenberk 2 5, Maarten De Vos 1 6
arxiv-2509-00102.description: Abstract Transformer-based foundation models for Electrocardiograms (ECGs) have recently achieved impressive performance in many downstream applications. However, the internal representations of such models across layers have not been fully understood and exploited. An important question arises: Does the final layer of the pre-trained Transformer model, the de facto representational layer, provide optimal performance for downstream tasks?

pmc-10670150.title: Representation Learning Method for Circular Seal Based on Modified MLP-Mixer
pmc-10670150.creator: Yuan Cao, You Zhou, Zhiwen Zhang, Enyi Yao
pmc-10670150.description: This study proposes Stamp-MLP, an enhanced seal impression representation learning technique based on MLP-Mixer. Instead of using the patch linear mapping preprocessing method, this technique uses circular seal remapping, which reserves the seals’ underlying pixel-level information. In the proposed Stamp-MLP, the average pooling is replaced by a global pooling of attention to extract the information more comprehensively.

pmc-11676687.title: Delayed Sowing Reduced Verticillium Wilt by Altering Soil Temperature and Humidity to Enhance Beneficial Rhizosphere Bacteria of Sunflower
pmc-11676687.creator: Jianfeng Yang, Shuo Jia, Tie Li, Jian Zhang, Yuanyuan Zhang, Jianjun Hao, Jun Zhao, Mohamed Hijri
pmc-11676687.description: Sunflower Verticillium Wilt (SVW) caused by Verticillium dahliae is a significant threat to sunflower production in China. This soilborne disease is difficult to control. It has been observed that delayed sowing reduces the severity of SVW on different varieties and across various locations.

pmc-12640058.title: Pilot Randomized Trial of Dialysis Less Frequently in the Elderly: The DLITE Study
pmc-12640058.creator: Christine A. White, Hasitha Welihinda, Andrew G. Day, Daren K. Heyland, Rachel M. Holden

The hemodialysis (HD) prescription that provides the best outcomes for this distinct population with reduced life expectancy is unknown.

pmc-13130624.title: Histone methyl-transferase G9a inhibition boosts the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in experimental hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13130624.creator: Elena Adan-Villaescusa, Borja Castello-Uribe, Iker Uriarte, Eva Santamaria, Roberto Barbero, Miriam Belzunce, Amaya López-Pascual, Maria Ujue Latasa, Jasmin Elurbide, Emiliana Valbuena-Goiricelaya, Agavni Mesropian, Guillem Cano-Segarra, Ana Hernández de Sande, Lorenzo Nevi, Simone Carotti, Umberto
pmc-13130624.description: SummaryImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) transform cancer therapy, but their efficacy in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains limited due to tumor-intrinsic immune evasion. We investigate the epigenetic regulator G9a (EHMT2) as a driver of immune resistance and evaluate pharmacologic inhibition as a therapeutic strategy. G9a expression is analyzed across human HCC cohorts and correlated with transcriptomic signatures predictive of ICI response.
